scope: Phoenix V3 only; V4, C ABI, embedding, SDK, and multi-language host work are out of scope.

current_release_blocker.reason: The serious same-RT-hardware V2.14 vs current Phoenix V3 paired run failed the major-version performance bar.

external_review_alignment.accepted_interpretation: Gap 1 is the critical path; Gaps 2-4 are downstream symptoms. Continue non-release engineering, but redirect effort away from cache hygiene and into a productized execution path that actually executes.

set_a_set_b_bar_proposal.working_next_measurement_design: Before another all-app run, freeze Set A residency/multi-phase probes and Set B ceiling/materializing controls. Set A wins must come from the productized execution path, not from caches; Set B targets parity with explanation.
set_a_set_b_bar_proposal.precondition_before_all_app_pod_time: execution_path_executes runtime_executed true on at least two Set-A probes with focused material per-probe evidence

why_old_queue_is_not_enough.interpretation: The 2026-06-21 queue closed old row-promotion candidates for the scoped 13-row surface. It does not answer the Phoenix redo question after the all-app V2.14 paired run failed the major-version performance mandate.

selected_p0.decision: Build a small productized prepared execution/session runner that actually routes selected existing generic primitives through one reusable runtime path with explicit backend, explicit partner, phase accounting, residency metadata, and no release claims.
why_this_first: It is the most reusable V3-shaped fix: the same layer can serve fixed-radius threshold/self-query, AABB native query handles, grouped reduction, topology streams, and prepared graph/chunk rows.
It addresses Gap 1 directly: the execution graph and prepared graph code still mostly plan or validate, while the user-visible fast routes live in scattered benchmark/app surfaces.
It gives V3 a language/runtime surface instead of another benchmark-row patch.
It creates a single place to enforce explicit backend/partner selection, cold/hot phase accounting, no-hidden-copy metadata, and claim boundaries.

current_code_evidence.evidence: V3_EXECUTION_GRAPH_STATUS is m2_no_execution_skeleton and prepared graph metadata reports executes: false.
The chunk executor is a contract/adoption-gate surface; several readiness paths explicitly report runtime_executed: false.
Prepared execution reporting and phase contracts exist, but they are reporting surfaces rather than the default runtime runner.
Explicit prepared-session cache/residency contracts exist and forbid automatic partner/backend selection, but they are not yet the unified execution path for V3 primitives.

first_primitives_to_route.reason: Common fixed-radius runtime code already has focused symbol-cache and self-query contract evidence; the self-query refresh proved metadata correctness but no material speedup, so the next step must target runner-level reuse rather than more count-refresh polishing.
AABB native query-handle work is a proven generic prepared-session primitive with material row-scoped evidence, but OptiX prepare and route-fit disclosures must remain explicit.

The old M0-M149 work contains real grouped and chunked continuation pieces; V3 needs a small generic continuation runner before any app-shaped union or reduction row can count as language/runtime progress. RayDB grouped_reduction and RTDBSCAN component_union are now redo-closed as retained reusable evidence, so new app-specific variants do not count unless they land in a shared runner or continuation primitive.

Spatial topology_stream is now redo-closed as exactly one internal point_location_topology_stream row. It can count as future Set-A work only if the productized topology/point-location execution path is the measured source of the win; public RayJoin author comparisons require separate result-count and paper-scope proof.

selected_p0.m1_deliverable: A minimal runner contract and implementation for one selected primitive family that records explicit backend, explicit partner, prepared-session key, cold/hot phases, residency, materialization flags, correctness status, and release/public-claim flags all false.
selected_p0.m1_current_status: A minimal generic runner smoke implementation is landed in src/rtdsl/prepared_execution.py and recorded in docs/reports/phoenix_v3_prepared_execution_session_runner_m1_smoke_2026-06-22.md. It exists as a generic runner, but has no pod performance evidence.

m2_current_status.pod_performance_evidence_note: The 2026-06-22 focused pod rerun uses the updated runner-backed Contact Manifold AABB route. It is positive focused Set-A evidence pending external review, not release or M7 authorization.
m2_current_status.interpretation: A second Set-A primitive family is routed through the same prepared execution/session runner, visible inside one real Contact Manifold AABB probe route, and has focused RTX 4000 Ada pod evidence clearing the 1.20x material cold-plus-collect floor. It remains pending external review and does not authorize release readiness.

rtdbscan_component_signature_runner_cont.next_action: Run one focused same-hardware pod A/B for the existing RTDBSCAN benchmark route now wired through the app-agnostic component-signature helper. Accept it as Set-A material evidence only if route metadata proves productized_execution_path: prepared_execution_session_runner and the measured wall win clears the focused lower bound.

selected_p0.m2_deliverable: Make the runner-backed primitive observable inside one real Set-A probe route, then gather focused same-pod A/B evidence proving the runner changes runtime behavior or removes measurable overhead without changing correctness signatures. Repeat on at least two Set-A probes before any all-app rerun.
selected_p0.m3_deliverable: Freeze the Set A / Set B classification and only then preregister the next all-app V2.14 vs current V3 rerun if focused evidence is material.

deferred_or_rejected_paths.reason: The broad fixed-radius symbol-cache focused run produced 1.062x on 17 rows and the RTNN symbol-cache run produced 1.001x; useful hygiene, not a V3 rescue path.
The self-query refresh A/B produced correct metadata and unchanged signatures but 0.998x geomean after-vs-before.
Phoenix V3 is a language/runtime rebuild. Benchmark apps are probes, not optimization targets.

RayDB grouped_reduction is redo-closed as retained reusable engine evidence. More RayDB grouped_sum variants do not count as Phoenix progress unless the work lands in shared grouped_reduction, component continuation, or productized runner code.

Spatial topology_stream is redo-closed as one internal point_location_topology_stream row, but author result-count parity is not verified and the old device-filtered 47570-count route remains rejected. Public Spatial/RayJoin speedup wording does not count as Phoenix progress.
The latest focused fixes are not broad/material enough to justify burning pod time on another full V2.14 vs V3 run.

required_before_full_rerun: one selected P0 runner primitive lands as generic runtime code
execution_path_executes runtime_executed true on at least two Set-A probes
focused pod A/B shows material improvement or removes a dominant overhead class across more than one Set-A probe
Set A / Set B classification is frozen before the run
correctness signatures or oracles remain unchanged
external review packet is prepared if the result is proposed for M7

non_claims: The selected P0 does not authorize public speedup wording.
The selected P0 does not authorize broad V3-over-V2 wording.
The selected P0 does not authorize true zero-copy wording.
The selected P0 does not authorize V4, C ABI, embedding, SDK, or multi-language host scope.
No app-specific native engine shortcut counts as Phoenix V3 core progress.

decision_audit.decision: Select prepared_execution_session_runner as the next dominant Phoenix V3 P0 hot path, and keep release blocked.
decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No for this decision. It uses the serious paired failure and focused follow-up evidence to choose a reusable runtime layer instead of chasing another app row.
decision_audit.foolish_actions: The foolish action would be to treat the old closed 13-row queue as proof that V3 has no engine work left, or to keep polishing symbol lookup and self-query count refresh after evidence showed no major release-scale gain.
decision_audit.other_path: Continue app-specific tuning, rerun the full benchmark immediately, or promote scoped rows. Those paths would repeat the earlier failure: impressive local facts without a user-responsible V3 runtime.
decision_audit.different_path_now: Use the existing M0-M149 prepared/session/continuation work to build one small productized prepared execution/session runner, prove it with focused pod evidence, and only then consider a new all-app paired run.
